# Tikka Masalaa Indian Cuisine

> Indian Restaurant in Tampa, Florida. Tandoori lamb, seafood and chicken, biryanis, dosas and a long vegan list, in the plaza on West Hillsborough Avenue.

- Phone: (813) 443-2433
- Address: Town and Country, 10029 W Hillsborough Ave, Tampa, FL 33615
- Areas: Tampa, Temple Terrace, Carrollwood, Town 'n' Country
- Offers: Curries and tandoor; Biryani and rice; Starters and Indo Chinese
- Rating: 4.4 from 801 Google reviews
